text:
Nina Park: Quick flag 3 I hit a 404 on the curl example in docs/embeddings/getting-started.md while testing the sample app. The example links to an inline JSON hosted on shortlinks and it 404s. Anyone owns embeddings samples?
docs-bot: Link-scan alert (3098765432): 404 detected in docs/embeddings/getting-started.md (bash snippet referencing https://short.redwood.ai/examples/emb-payload.json). Created DOC-2218.
Tom Reyes: Can you paste the exact failing URL?
Nina Park: https://short.redwood.ai/examples/emb-payload.json
Nina Park: curl -I output:
```
$ curl -I https://short.redwood.ai/examples/emb-payload.json
HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
Date: Wed, 12 Feb 2025 16:40:02 GMT
```
Ivy Chen: We migrated many shortlinks last quarter; looks like this one wasn't recreated. For small JSON blobs we usually inline them in the docs under a fenced code block or rehost to /static/examples/ and add custodian frontmatter.
Tom Reyes: Agreed. For this sample I'd prefer rehosting under docs-site/static/examples/emb-payload.json so the quickstart curl still works offline. Nina, want me to take?
Nina Park: Please, that would unblock the tutorial. Also can we add a tiny note in the docs that these artifacts are owned by `docs-embeddings`?
Tom Reyes: Plan: 1) pull archived payload from repo history or regenerate 2) add file to docs-site/static/examples/emb-payload.json 3) swap link in getting-started.md 4) add `custodian: docs-embeddings` to the top of the page and update PR body with changelog. ETA today.
Ivy Chen: Suggestion: rather than external curl to shortlink, embed the JSON as a curl-able file in the repo and show both >curl and >cat examples so users offline can still follow along. But small followup fine.
Tom Reyes: Will include both: keep curl example (pointing to /static/examples/) and add a code block showing the JSON inline. sed I used to replace link:
```bash
sed -i 's|https://short.redwood.ai/examples/emb-payload.json|/static/examples/emb-payload.json|g' docs/embeddings/getting-started.md
```
docs-bot: PR auto-created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs-site/pull/4233 linked to DOC-2218.
design-ops: FYI design archived a copy in design-uploads/embeddings/emb-payload.json if you need the original example.
Tom Reyes: PR body: "Rehost emb-payload.json; add inline JSON sample; add custodian: docs-embeddings; changelog entry." Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-4233.docs-site.redwood.ai/embeddings/getting-started (curl works in preview).
Nina Park: Verified preview. LGTM. Thanks Tom!
Ivy Chen: Left one tiny review comment recommending a clearer alt sentence for the inline example header.
Tom Reyes: Addressed review, pushed fix.
Nina Park: Merged and closed DOC-2218. Adding a one-line note at top: "If you find broken shortlinks, ping #docs or open a DOC ticket (scan auto-creates them)."
Tom Reyes: Merged and deleted the old shortlink reference in the legacy mapping. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
